notes.title: MOR...E TRAINER is Now in Spanish
notes.content:
The main thing in the update is the Spanish interface language and the Spanish mnemonics for the Mnemonic Method.

Also added customizable display colors.

notes.title: Release on Android
notes.content: Hi everyone! Now Mor...e Trainer App is also available on the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dds.lmorse.lmorse]Android platform[/url]!

notes.title: New sound engine
notes.content:
Hello. We made an important update, which includes:

[list]
[*] full update of the sound engine (now everything sounds softer and smoother)
[*] small fix speed of playing Morse code sounds
[*] adding full screen mode
[*] minor fixes
[/list]

[i]We recommend that after starting the application in the "Settings -> Main" section, click on the "Default"[/i]
